gesetz.fassung.scharf.hinweis: A big step that keeps your line. Opponents take to the barricades, a few MPs in your own camp defect.
gesetz.fassung.kompromiss.hinweis: A middle step with concessions. Wins votes from the opposition; both sides grumble, neither breaks.
gesetz.fassung.verwaessert.hinweis: A small step, almost certain to pass. Its supporters feel betrayed.
gesetz.v.gv_mindestlohn.satz: The biggest single purchasing-power decision of the year: every percentage point flows into wages, prices and the social funds.
gesetz.v.gv_mindestlohn.kompromiss: Usual deal: a rise just above inflation, with relief on employer contributions.
gesetz.v.gv_einkommensteuer.satz: More take-home pay for everyone on a wage. The hole in the budget stays, and the Ministry of Finance knows it.
gesetz.v.gv_einkommensteuer.kompromiss: Usual deal: higher allowances at the bottom, the top brackets stay.
gesetz.v.gv_vermoegen.satz: Those who own houses and land should pay more. The treasury fills up, the owners do the maths.
gesetz.v.gv_vermoegen.kompromiss: Usual deal: a high exemption for the home you live in, a surcharge only from the third flat.
gesetz.v.gv_mwst.satz: Bread, medicine and electricity should get cheaper. Whether retailers pass the cut on is another question.
gesetz.v.gv_mwst.kompromiss: Usual deal: limited to one year and a short list of goods.
gesetz.v.gv_unternehmensteuer.satz: Lower corporate tax for investment and exports. The unions call it a gift to the holdings.
gesetz.v.gv_unternehmensteuer.kompromiss: Usual deal: cuts only on reinvested profits and export earnings.
gesetz.v.gv_renten.satz: More than seventeen million pensioners wait for every adjustment. Every extra lira is a lira missing elsewhere.
gesetz.v.gv_renten.kompromiss: Usual deal: a higher minimum pension, regular pensions only in line with inflation.
gesetz.v.gv_gewerkschaft.satz: Easier to found unions, fewer bans on strikes. Employers fear a winter of wage rounds.
gesetz.v.gv_gewerkschaft.kompromiss: Usual deal: lower thresholds for collective agreements, strike bans in essential services stay.
gesetz.v.gv_energiepreisbremse.satz: The state caps electricity and gas prices for households. The bill lands at BOTAŞ and in the end in the budget.
gesetz.v.gv_energiepreisbremse.kompromis: Usual deal: capped only for basic consumption, market price above that.
gesetz.v.gv_preiswahrheit.satz: Energy costs what it costs. That relieves the budget and the central bank and hits every household at the next meter reading.
gesetz.v.gv_preiswahrheit.kompromiss: Usual deal: phased in over two years, with a social tariff for the poorest.
gesetz.v.gv_kernenergie.satz: New sites after Akkuyu, a dedicated regulator, long-term offtake contracts. Locals protest.
gesetz.v.gv_kernenergie.kompromiss: Usual deal: one second site, stricter oversight, a say for the province.
gesetz.v.gv_mietdeckel.satz: Rent increases are capped. Tenants breathe easier, landlords build less and prefer letting to tourists.
gesetz.v.gv_mietdeckel.kompromiss: Usual deal: cap only on existing leases, new lettings free.
gesetz.v.gv_wohnungsbau.satz: Large-scale public housing through TOKİ. Building sites create jobs, but not every town hall plays along.
gesetz.v.gv_wohnungsbau.kompromiss: Usual deal: earthquake regions first, private developers as partners.
gesetz.v.gv_bauamnestie.satz: Unlicensed buildings are legalised for a fee. The till rings, the engineers warn of the next earthquake.
gesetz.v.gv_bauamnestie.kompromiss: Usual deal: amnesty only with a structural survey, not in first-degree earthquake zones.
gesetz.v.gv_polizei.satz: More officers, more powers to search and detain. Security or arbitrariness, depending on whom you ask.
gesetz.v.gv_polizei.kompromiss: Usual deal: more staff and equipment, new powers only under judicial review.
gesetz.v.gv_versammlung.satz: Rallies need only be notified, not approved, and governors ban fewer of them.
gesetz.v.gv_versammlung.kompromiss: Usual deal: notification stays mandatory, bans only with reasons and a fast appeal.
gesetz.v.gv_netzinhalte.satz: Platforms must delete content within hours, blocks come faster. Against disinformation, says the government.
gesetz.v.gv_netzinhalte.kompromiss: Usual deal: takedowns only on court order, blocks time-limited.
gesetz.v.gv_medienaufsicht.satz: The regulator gets tougher fines and can revoke licences. The broadcasters are already practising self-censorship.
gesetz.v.gv_medienaufsicht.kompromiss: Usual deal: higher fines, licence revocation only after a court ruling.
gesetz.v.gv_wehrdienst.satz: Shorter conscription, more professional soldiers. The young cheer, the General Staff expects gaps.
gesetz.v.gv_wehrdienst.kompromiss: Usual deal: a few months shorter, more paid exemption.
gesetz.v.gv_justizreform.satz: Faster trials, clearer appointments, less pre-trial detention. Investors and Brussels are watching closely.
gesetz.v.gv_justizreform.kompromiss: Usual deal: procedural deadlines and digitalisation, appointments left untouched.
gesetz.v.gv_richterstellen.satz: Thousands of new judge and prosecutor posts against the backlog of cases.
gesetz.v.gv_richterstellen.kompromiss: Usual deal: posts spread over three years, overloaded big cities first.
gesetz.v.gv_antikorruption.satz: Open tenders, asset declarations, an independent investigative office. Not everyone in the apparatus is pleased.
gesetz.v.gv_antikorruption.kompromiss: Usual deal: transparent tenders, the investigative office stays under the ministry.
gesetz.v.gv_imamhatip.satz: More religious schools and more religious lessons. A home for some, a step away from the secular state for others.
gesetz.v.gv_imamhatip.kompromiss: Usual deal: new schools only where there is demand, free choice of religious lessons.
gesetz.v.gv_gewaltschutz.satz: Faster protection orders, more women's shelters, tougher sentences. Conservative associations warn of an attack on the family.
gesetz.v.gv_gewaltschutz.kompromiss: Usual deal: more shelters and protection orders, no new legal concepts.
gesetz.v.gv_minderheiten.satz: Teaching in the mother tongue, cemevis as houses of worship, return of foundation property. The nationalists speak of division.
gesetz.v.gv_minderheiten.kompromiss: Usual deal: mother tongue as an elective, cemevis recognised without state money.
gesetz.v.gv_friedensprozess.satz: A legal framework for disarmament, return and reintegration. Without a law every step remains a revocable promise.
gesetz.v.gv_friedensprozess.kompromiss: Usual deal: reintegration first, amnesty only for members without violent crimes.
gesetz.v.gv_rueckkehr.satz: Voluntary return of refugees with incentives and deadlines. What voluntary means is decided at the border.
gesetz.v.gv_rueckkehr.kompromiss: Usual deal: return grants and safe zones, no deportation without individual review.
gesetz.grund.ende: The term in office has ended.
gesetz.grund.ruht: The issue rests for {tage, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}}: parliament has only just decided.
gesetz.grund.ausgeschoepft: Exhausted: it cannot go further in this direction.
gesetz.grund.keinErlass: This needs a law: a decree may not regulate it.
gesetz.eingebracht.text: “{titel}” has been introduced. The vote is in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
gesetz.erlass.text: By presidential decree: “{titel}” applies immediately. The Constitutional Court rules in {tage} days.
gesetz.erlass.warum: {pk} capital and some trust: governing past parliament is fast and vulnerable. The court strikes it down with a probability of about {p, prozent}.
gesetz.folge.scharf: “{titel}” passed in its hard-line version. Cheering: {fuer}. Resistance announced: {gegen}.
gesetz.folge.kompromiss: “{titel}” passed as a compromise. Satisfied: {fuer}. Grumbling: {gegen}.
gesetz.folge.warum: The version decides who wins: what passes hard binds your own people and makes enemies; what passes watered down pleases no one.
gesetz.folge.strasse: Calls for rallies against “{titel}” in Istanbul, Ankara and İzmir; leading the way: {gegen}.
gesetz.folge.strasseWarum: Protest pressure in the big cities rises; if it lasts, a movement can grow out of it.
gesetz.folge.rathaeuser: {n} big opposition-run town halls announce they will implement “{titel}” only to the letter.
gesetz.folge.rathaeuserWarum: What is implemented locally depends on the mayors. Whoever does not hold the big cities sees their laws work more slowly there.
gesetz.klage.text: The {partei} takes “{titel}” to the Constitutional Court. A ruling is expected in about {tage} days.
gesetz.klage.warum: Fundamental rights are at stake. Given the court's composition, it strikes the law down with a probability of about {p, prozent}.
gesetz.gericht.aufgehoben.erlass: The Constitutional Court annuls the decree “{titel}”.
gesetz.gericht.aufgehobenWarum: The measure falls back to its old level. The capital is spent, and the government stands in court as the loser.
gesetz.gericht.bestaetigt.erlass: The Constitutional Court dismisses the challenge to the decree “{titel}”.
gesetz.gericht.bestaetigtWarum: The measure stays. How the court rules depends on who sits on it.
gesetz.ui.zweck: Choose a bill, a version and the route. What is pressing now is at the top.
